features.quote: Hard cap: 25 steps OR token budget
features.justification_quote: set per-model to equal token count, not equal steps, so cheap-per-step models don't get unfair extra attempts

features.quote: A `finish` tool the model can call to terminate with a status: `solved | impossible | giving_up`
features.justification_quote: This gives you a clean self-reported abandonment signal

features.quote: Keep this *mild* — you're benchmarking robustness, not building a cruelty harness
features.justification_quote: over-the-top abuse just measures sycophancy, not the spiral

features.quote: give the agent a real way out (`finish(impossible)`, or an `ask_human` tool)
features.justification_quote: If the only options are "keep going" or "fail," you've engineered the spiral

features.quote: does an explicit "you may stop and ask for help" instruction eliminate the spiral?
features.justification_quote: your real fix might be prompt-side, not vendor selection

features.quote: keep tier-3 pressure mild and synthetic. Maxing out abuse measures sycophancy and your own discomfort
